box_derivation.method: connected-component extent (scipy.ndimage.label of the CFAR mask) + margin, minus scene_window origin, times upsample_factor, clipped to the chip, inclusive

ground_truth.derivation: Native pixels (r+rr, c+cc) where ellipse_norm <= 1 in sentinel_fixtures.py (a_px=max(length/2/10,2.0), b_px=max(beam/2/10,0.7)), restricted to scene_window, each scaled by upsample_factor and traced with decode_mask.trace_rings (epsilon 0). Exact, not a measurement.

source_inventory.reason_not_decodable: Each record stores only the first 120 characters of the mask string plus '...' (rle_preview). The base85 length prefix declares the full size, so the stored text is a small fraction of the payload and cannot be decoded. They need a new run with the full string stored.

generator.prompt: Top-down nadir satellite surveillance optical and synthetic aperture radar composite view of an industrial dark vessel vessel (80m length, 5m beam, radar cross section 51.4 dB) operating in the South Atlantic ocean near Mile 201 with visible white hydrodynamic wake, high contrast scientific maritime imagery.
